ordinals.title: Add persistent room objects — Frank's spatial memory
ordinals.finding: Added durable room objects with soft removal state, timestamps, placement provenance and bounded prompt projection; experiment results could materialize as persistent room objects. Demonstrates a useful distinction between durable spatial/object state and bounded context projection.

ordinals.title: Fix chat size toggle: preserve scroll position on resize
ordinals.finding: Viewport anchor preserved across density changes; usability detail only.

ordinals.title: Shift chat density range down: L=13px (was M), M=11px, S=10px
Add chat density toggle (S/M/L) in chat header
ordinals.finding: Alongside chat-density persistence, weather location detection used external IP geolocation with a timezone fallback and ultimately a hardcoded city fallback. Convenience-derived location must carry source/provenance/uncertainty and must not silently become durable personal ground truth.

ordinals.title: Disable Genesis: surgical deactivation, code preserved for reactivation
ordinals.finding: Genesis was comprehensively disabled across cognition, topology, UI, Web API, swarm edges and systemd/watchdog surfaces while preserving code for future reactivation. This records a capability-dependent subsystem lifecycle: unsupported autonomy should be deactivated coherently, not merely stopped at one process boundary.

ordinals.title: Fix mail: server-side read marking, proper persona/lang API, contacts
ordinals.finding: Email read state moved from local-only UI mutation to server synchronization; persona/language were moved into separate API fields and system prompt rather than prepended into user intent, reducing instruction-copy leakage. This is direct evidence for separating control metadata from user content and syncing visible state to authority.

ordinals.title: Add persona settings, signature editor, language selector for mail
ordinals.finding: Mail persona, language and signature became explicit persisted client configuration. Such profile/style metadata is a presentation/generation input and should remain separate from tool authority, trusted identity claims and immutable user facts.

ordinals.title: Add pagination, mark-all-read, fix header layout
ordinals.finding: Added bulk mark-all-read with confirmation and optimistic local state plus background server synchronization. Bulk external effects amplify the need for receipts/reconciliation even when the action is non-destructive.

ordinals.title: Overhaul mail page: fix all UX issues, add optimistic updates
ordinals.finding: Delete/spam were made optimistic and confirmation dialogs were added. This is part of the same lineage later diagnosed at k375/k376: optimistic projections require authoritative result reconciliation and rollback semantics.

ordinals.title: Update all papers to current architecture, add IAPT method paper
ordinals.finding: Multiple papers were rewritten from older architecture/model/entity terminology to current Rooms/Qwen/WebUI terminology and historical notes were removed. Current file contents therefore flatten history; Git versions must be preserved as document epochs rather than treating latest papers as faithful historical snapshots.

ordinals.title: Add IAPT method paper: Iterative Adversarial Personality Training
ordinals.finding: Introduced IAPT as interactive adaptive adversarial evaluation→failure analysis→targeted positive training data→LoRA iteration. This is important method provenance. Claimed novelty, turn counts, training duration and identity-score improvements remain source-reported until raw runs and scoring procedures are independently reconstructed.

ordinals.title: Light mode polish: warm gray backgrounds, matte accents, soft aurora
Add light/dark theme toggle to Neural Hub
ordinals.finding: Theme preference persisted client-side; no cognitive mechanism delta.

ordinals.title: Move E-PQ metrics into Swarm page, remove standalone E-PQ page
ordinals.finding: E-PQ/NAC/subconscious/neural metrics were consolidated into the Swarm view. UI consolidation can reduce divergent observer surfaces but does not itself unify underlying state authority.

ordinals.title: Remove overlay and writer — Web UI is the only interface
ordinals.finding: Large overlay/writer surfaces and associated desktop/systemd artifacts were deleted, making WebUI the single interaction entry point. Historical interface-specific state/persistence/effect paths are therefore superseded and must not be assumed current after this ordinal.

ordinals.title: Remove Llama-8B, DeepSeek, Ollama — Qwen2.5-3B only architecture
ordinals.finding: Removed multiple model backends/adapters and collapsed routing, health/service references and forced model modes onto Qwen2.5-3B. This materially changes capability/resource topology; downstream historical behavior must be interpreted against the active model epoch rather than one timeless 'Frank model'.

negative_results_preserved: A convenience location path could fall back from IP/timezone detection to a hardcoded city.
Genesis was fully disabled despite extensive prior integration because the available model was judged insufficiently reliable for self-improvement.
Client-only email read state did not survive reload until server synchronization was added.
Persona/language text mixed into user intent caused the model to copy instructions into generated mail.
Historical papers were rewritten to current architecture and had historical notes removed, flattening document history in the latest tree.
A previously multi-model architecture was later collapsed to a single 3B model, invalidating timeless model/topology assumptions.
Overlay and writer were deleted wholesale after extensive prior development, demonstrating large-surface supersession.
measurement_boundary: IAPT turn counts, durations, identity scores, claimed novelty, resource savings and any performance statements are source-reported historical claims only. This pass did not reproduce training/evaluation runs or current runtime behavior.

earned_work.reason: No row-level conceptual-dedup audit against HISTORICAL_EARNED_WORK was performed.
